answer: Trust propagates through an attestation graph by bounded-length walks under its normalized transition matrix; quartz, river, and mirror can simply label example vertices. For a Sybil cluster S with sparse external edges, low conductance φ(S) means little walk probability crosses into S within the trust horizon. Thus, if walks start in trusted territory, the cluster’s reachable voting weight is constrained by its cut capacity, rather than inflated by adding internal identities.
